repos.readme_note: README is a setup/ops guide (testnet, systemd service, sysctl tuning) with no descriptive prose. No LICENSE file found in repo root. Repo carries a disclaimer: experimental research code, no warranty, restricted in sanctioned jurisdictions.

Boilerplate for GenLayer 'intelligent contracts' platform: a football-betting smart contract with web access + LLM integration, validated via consensus across nodes. Python contracts, Next.js 15 + TypeScript frontend, direct-mode (mocked) tests plus full integration tests against GenLayer Studio.

repos.description: High performance self-hosted photo and video management solution
repos.readme_note: Self-hosted Google Photos alternative. NestJS backend, SvelteKit web frontend, Flutter mobile app. Features: auto backup, multi-user, shared albums, raw format support, EXIF/map metadata, search by metadata/objects/faces/CLIP embeddings, OAuth support.
